fields.Safety: No known issues. Commonly eaten as food in Asia
fields.Properties: Cool/Dry, nutritive, alterative, lymphatic, anti-tumor, diuretic
fields.Course Notes: Burdock root is so effective because it is a super food that is jammed-packed with essential nutrients. It helps regulate blood sugar. Herbalists commonly use for those with diabetes and blood sugar disorders.  It’s high in iron and helps strengthen liver and kidneys making it the first plant herbalists reach for wen treating hot skin eruptions such as psoriasis, eczema, herpes, acne, and boils. It’s commonly paired with red clover and/or dandelion to slow or eradicate tumors.

fields.Properties: Cool/Dry, nutritive, kidney/adrenal, trophorestorative, adaptogen, diuretic, astringent, hemostatic
fields.Course Notes: Nettles are diuretic and therefore drying.If you tend to have dry skin, eyes, or other symptoms of dryness you may want to add a pinch of marshmallow root or slippery elm bark to your infusion. Nettles can also be somewhat cooling and for this reason some people put a slice or two of fresh ginger in their infusions

fields.Safety: Although safe to use for many people, red clovers ability to thin the blood makes it a poor choice for pregnancy and for those already on blood thinners. Regular use of this plant should also be stopped before surgery.
fields.Properties: Cool/Dry, astringent, alterative, blood thinning, antispasmodic, expectorant, anti-tumor
fields.Course Notes: Red Clover is world renowned as anti-cancer herb. It is used in 33 different cultures as an aid against cancer. It is one ingredient in the famed Essiac Tea, and scientific studies have found 4 anti-tumor compounds in this miraculous Lapland. Besides being a strong ally for those dancing with cancer, red clover is a strong alterative, loosely defined as altering towards health. Rich in phytosterols, red clover nourishes hormones, making it an excellent choice for women going through menopause or for increasing fertility. It’s been used to treat dry, irritable coughs such as whooping cough and tuberculosis.  The infusion can also be used externally (as well as internally) to nourish the skin, eliminating eczema and psoriasis.

fields.Safety: Could potentially cause issues for people with gluten intolerance.
fields.Properties: Neutral/moist, nutritive, nervous system trophorestorative, relaxing nervine
fields.Course Notes: There is some debate as to whether or not oatstraw contains gluten. If you are gluten intolerant you may want to approach this one with caution.  Oatstraw is a wonderful restorative tonic, especially helpful to those feeling stressed or worn out. Regular use eases inflammation in your body which is especially helpful for those with Crohn’s disease, lupus, RA, or other autoimmune diseases. It’s a wonderful source of calcium and silicon for those wishing to strengthen their bones, teeth, and nails.

fields.Properties: Cool/Dry, astringent, tonic, uterine tonic, hemostatic, mild alternative
fields.Course Notes: Red Raspberry is often considered a woman’s herb and is commonly used especially during pregnancy. It gently eases nausea and morning sickness. It is scientifically proven to ease uterine and intestinal spasms as well as strengthen the uterine wall. These actions help to ease labor pains and facilitate births. There is also evidence that regular infusions taken during the third trimester reduce the incidence of false labor. For males, red raspberry has a toning effect for the male reproductive system. It has been used in cases of enuresis, spermatorrhea, premature ejaculation, impotency and sterility.   Raspberry leaves have the ability to promote healthy bones, nails, teeth, skin. It’s common to find paired with red clover as a fertility tonic for both men and women.
